entities.name: Query 136-aa membrane protein
observations: 136 aa; highly hydrophobic sequence with multiple predicted membrane-spanning segments.
Exact sequence match to UniProt Q9CME9, annotated as UPF0299 membrane protein PM0880.
Pfam LrgA domain PF03788.20 spans residues 19–111.
Most likely bacterial cytoplasmic/inner membrane localization; function is likely LrgA-family membrane protein, but exact biochemical activity is not established from this evidence.

entities.name: Q9CME9
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference with 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated localization: cell inner membrane; multi-pass membrane protein.
Annotated as UPF0299 membrane protein PM0880.

entities.name: LrgA family
observations: Query contains Pfam LrgA domain PF03788.20 at residues 19–111 with i-Evalue 1.6e-25.
LrgA-family membership supports a small bacterial multi-pass membrane protein; substrate specificity and precise mechanism remain unresolved here.
